name: The Third Tourist
detailed_description:
The Third Tourist is a quirky, story-driven first-person stealth adventure set in the compact open world of Sunhollow Bay—an idyllic seaside town hiding more than its fair share of secrets.

You play as Bryce, a city girl with an unusual problem: she’s possessed by a demon lord. To win back her freedom, she must track down his lost lieutenants. That means sneaking, scheming, and deceiving her way through town—breaking into homes, manipulating the unsuspecting, and doing whatever it takes to stay ahead.

He wants to return to the underworld. She wants to be free. But the longer she plays along, the more the lines she thought she'd never cross start to blur.

Features:

  • Gather intel by chatting with quirky locals, collecting books, and piecing together notes.

  • Sneak into homes, businesses, and enemy facilities—avoid detection using familiar stealth mechanics.

  • Craft potions, traps, and tools to aid in your mission.

  • Complete quests to unlock new skills, deeper mysteries, and unexpected choices.

But beware—you’re not the only one searching.

No guns. No backup. Just you, your demon, and a growing taste for the chaos that ensues.
